Book correction: The book prints the decay function as Q(t) = Q\left(\tfrac{1}{2}\right)^{t/h}, using the same letter Q for the initial quantity. It should read Q(t) = Q_0\left(\tfrac{1}{2}\right)^{t/h}, where Q_0 = 200 g is the initial quantity and h = 2 years is the half-life. The answer key (book page 296) numbers this answer as "8" ("25 grams"); the value is correct.
